text: In the DeepESN cascade, the ___ of layer ℓ is fed as the input to layer ℓ+1 (with layer 1 receiving the external input u_t).
explanation: Layers are stacked so that layer ℓ's state vector x_t^(ℓ) drives layer ℓ+1 (with the convention x_t^(0) = u_t). Because each layer sees the already-smoothed state of the one below, upper layers inherit progressively slower dynamics — the mechanism that produces the emergent timescale hierarchy.
